caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet placed against a plain, off-white background. The cabinet has two distinct sections: the upper section features two doors with rectangular, mirrored panels framed in red, and a vertical strip separating the doors. Above the doors is a horizontal segment with a decorative top rail in a gray-blue color, which has evenly spaced rectangular cutouts. Below the doors, the lower section of the cabinet has two wide drawers with visible wood grain and small round knobs, and the drawers are bordered by thin red lines. The cabinet has straight edges and a slightly arched base with feet at each end. The artist's signature, "Richard Taylor," is written in blue in the bottom right corner.
title: Toy Cupboard
